answer: To deter Sybils in an ocean of AI agents, each registered public key must harbor a locked 20-USDC smart-contract bond and burn 2 USDC as an irreversible fee, verified via on-chain deposit receipts. For N fake keys, an attacker pays a strictly linear cost of 2N USDC permanently lost plus 20N USDC in capital lockup; resetting keys to escape double-signing penalties triggers slashing via cryptographic equivocation proofs, sending a costly ripple through their budget.
